benchmark_name: TerraShift Saudi Deployment Multi-Model Reference Benchmark (v6.1 - Authenticated GEE & STAC)
description: Empirical ablation comparing 7 change detection paradigms across 4 Saudi reference corridors using live Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A COGs and authenticated Google Earth Engine AlphaEarth V1 + Dynamic World V1.

methodology_notes.zero_synthetic_guarantee: All Google AlphaEarth ('GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL') and Dynamic World ('GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1') rasters were fetched from authenticated Google Earth Engine project 'terrashift' with allow_synthetic=False enforced.
methodology_notes.localization_matching_protocol: Greedy 1-to-1 matching requiring both minimum physical parcel overlap (>= 3,500 m² or >= 8% parcel coverage) AND minimum localization purity (PoC = Intersection / AlertArea >= 0.15 and IoU >= 0.05). Sprawling polygons that overlap a reference box without localizing it are rejected as False Positives.
methodology_notes.geometric_area_clipping: Every vectorized polygon is geometrically intersected with the exact WGS84 AOI bounding box before computing WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic area.
methodology_notes.reference_provenance_disclosure: The 19 positive events and 4 negative control zones are coarse parcel-level bounding boxes curated by the project author from multi-date Sentinel-2 visual/spectral inspection and known Saudi development sites. They are used strictly for event-level localization evaluation, never treated as dense pixel-level training labels.
methodology_notes.macro_vs_pooled_reporting: Both Pooled (micro sum across all 19 events) and Corridor Macro-Averaged precision, recall, and F1 are reported side-by-side.
